name: wireguard
description: A WireGuard tunnel between ISP1 and ISP2: interface, peer, handshake, and the allowed-address route. Keys are real key pairs captured from RouterOS 7.16 so the handshake actually establishes on the real routers.
steps: /interface wireguard peers add interface=wg0 public-key="wCBSeaW8oKLUZxJsxnxlPkT869AEmno1gYQalFQW5wA=" endpoint-address=10.1.1.2 endpoint-port=13231 allowed-address=10.9.9.2/32,192.168.20.0/24
/interface wireguard peers add interface=wg0 public-key="gbBBjNTTNCrNtPlGhUBGiDGaYO3tWRGeoyPeEsE1jHo=" endpoint-address=10.1.1.1 endpoint-port=13231 allowed-address=10.9.9.1/32,192.168.10.0/24
